intro: Botswana's sprinters have become world stars.

chapters.title: Athletics
text: Letsile Tebogo won the 200 m at the 2024 Olympics, Botswana's first gold, and the men's 4×400 m relay won silver. Nijel Amos won 800 m silver in 2012.

chapters.title: Football
text: The Zebras have played at the Africa Cup of Nations.
